pieces.doc: Optional positioning anchor. When present, the popover is positioned against this element instead of `[forPopoverTrigger]` — useful when "what opens it" and "where it appears" are different elements (a button opens the popover but it's anchored to a row, a text-selection range, a cursor follower, etc.).

Optional visual arrow inside `ForPopoverContent`. Registers itself with the popover context so floating-ui's `arrow` middleware can position it along the surface edge that points at the trigger. Style size and color yourself — the directive only sets `position`, `left`/`top`, and the opposite-side offset.
Button that closes the surrounding popover when clicked. Apply on a `<button>` inside `[forPopoverContent]`. Bypasses `dismissible` — an explicit close button is always honored.

The popover surface. Carries `role="dialog"` (non-modal — `aria-modal` is absent per APG), is portaled to `document.body`, and is positioned by `@floating-ui/dom` against the registered `[forPopoverTrigger]`.

Convenience: gives the host element a stable id and registers it as the popover's accessible description (`aria-describedby`). Apply on a paragraph or similar text element inside `[forPopoverContent]`.
Convenience: gives the host element a stable id and registers it as the popover's accessible name (`aria-labelledby`). Apply on a heading element (`<h2>`, `<h3>`...) inside `[forPopoverContent]`.
Button that toggles the popover when clicked. Apply on a focusable element — preferably a `<button>` — so keyboard users can reach it.
Headless implementation of the [WAI-ARIA Modeless Dialog pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/), positioned against an internal trigger via `@floating-ui/dom`.

inputs.name: side
inputs.doc: Side the popover is anchored to. Defaults to `'bottom'`. Pair with `align` for the full positioning API (`side="bottom" align="start"`).

inputs.name: align
inputs.doc: Alignment along the chosen `side`. Defaults to `'center'`.

inputs.name: sideOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) between trigger and content along the *main* axis (perpendicular to `side`). Default `8`. Forwarded to floating-ui's `offset` middleware. Mirrors Radix's `sideOffset`.

inputs.name: alignOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) along the cross axis (parallel to `side`). Default `0`.

inputs.name: avoidCollisions
inputs.doc: When `true` (default), `flip` and `shift` keep the popover inside the viewport. Disable for strict positioning where overflow is acceptable.

inputs.name: collisionPadding
inputs.doc: Padding (px) applied uniformly to the `flip`, `shift`, and `size` middlewares. Default `8`. Mirrors Radix's `collisionPadding`.

inputs.name: arrowPadding
inputs.doc: Padding (px) for the `arrow` middleware so the arrow stays inside any rounded corners on the popover content. Default `0`.

inputs.name: sticky
inputs.doc: Stickiness behaviour for `shift`. `'partial'` (default) lets the popover shift to stay visible. `'always'` disables `shift` so the popover keeps its requested placement even off-screen. `false` is treated as `'partial'`.

inputs.name: hideWhenDetached
inputs.doc: When `true`, sets `data-detached=""` on the content while the trigger has scrolled off all clipping ancestors. Use to fade out popovers tied to scrolled-away triggers.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.doc: When true, trigger interaction is ignored and any open popover stays open until the consumer flips `open` themselves. Disable on the trigger side; the content side keeps its dismissable behavior unaffected.

inputs.name: dismissible
inputs.doc: When true (default), Escape, pointer-down outside, and focus outside close the popover. Disable for confirm flows that must be answered via `[forPopoverClose]` (or by setting `open` programmatically).

inputs.name: returnFocus
inputs.doc: When true (default), focus returns to the trigger on close.

inputs.name: initialFocus
inputs.doc: Where to send focus when content mounts. `'first'` (default) finds the first focusable descendant; `'container'` focuses the content box itself (useful when there's nothing focusable inside).

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.doc: Manual `aria-label` on the content. Use this when no visible title element exists.

outputs.name: escapeKeyDown
outputs.doc: Fires when the user presses Escape while this popover is the topmost dismissable layer. Call `preventDefault()` on the emitted veto to suppress the automatic close. The native `KeyboardEvent` is available on `.event`.

outputs.name: pointerDownOutside
outputs.doc: Fires when a pointer goes down outside the popover (and outside the trigger). Call `preventDefault()` on the veto to suppress the automatic close. The native `PointerEvent` is on `.event`.

outputs.name: focusOutside
outputs.doc: Fires when focus moves outside the popover and trigger. Call `preventDefault()` on the veto to suppress the automatic close.

outputs.name: interactOutside
outputs.doc: Composite event: fires alongside `pointerDownOutside` and `focusOutside` and shares their veto state — `preventDefault()` on either one suppresses the automatic close.

outputs.name: autoFocusOnOpen
outputs.doc: Fires just before the popover sends focus into itself on mount. Call `preventDefault()` on the veto to skip the imperative focus move — useful when opening a popover from an input you want to keep focused.

outputs.name: autoFocusOnClose
outputs.doc: Fires just before focus returns to the trigger on unmount. Call `preventDefault()` on the veto to suppress the return-focus.

models.name: open
models.doc: Two-way bindable. Whether the popover is currently shown. The `model()` change emitter (`(openChange)`) fires only on internal transitions (trigger click, Escape, outside dismissal), never on consumer writes via `[(open)]` — observe state changes without binding back.
